facts.text: Rosewood Abu Dhabi is on Al Maryah Island.
facts.excerpt: Nestled against the stunning backdrop of Al Maryah Island, the pool at Rosewood Abu Dhabi offers an oasis of tranquility and luxury amidst the bustling city.

facts.text: The hotel's accommodation blends contemporary elegance, local influence and waterfront views.
facts.excerpt: Elegant city escapes that harmoniously blend contemporary elegance, local influence and waterfront views

facts.text: Dragon's Tooth is a speakeasy bar inspired by the 1920s Shanghai jazz movement, reached through the Tea Room of the hotel's Dai Pai Dong restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Taking inspiration from the 1920s Shanghai Jazz movement, Dragon's Tooth emerges as a speakeasy bar, accessible through the hotel's restaurant, Dai Pai Dong's Tea Room.

facts.text: Dai Pai Dong is the hotel's Cantonese restaurant.
facts.excerpt: A celebration of authentic Cantonese cuisine, where tradition comes alive through authentic specialties

facts.text: Dai Pai Dong serves a Yum Cha dim sum brunch with dumplings, roasted meats and desserts.
facts.excerpt: Enjoy a decidedly different brunch with the “Yum Cha” Dim Sum Brunch at Dai Pai Dong. Experience a selection of delectable dumplings, roasted meats and desserts.

facts.text: Majlis by Pierre Hermé combines the setting of a majlis with a Parisian patisserie and Pierre Hermé's creations.
facts.excerpt: Majlis by Pierre Hermé embraces the warmth and community of the Majlis, seamlessly woven with the elegance of a Parisian pâtisserie and Pierre Hermé’s exquisite creations.

facts.text: Hidden Bar focuses on gin, with a gin collection and house-infused vermouths.
facts.excerpt: An unrivaled gin collection and house-infused vermouths set apart Hidden Bar.

facts.text: Hidden Bar has a terrace looking over the water at sunset.
facts.excerpt: At Hidden Bar, settle into the terrace as the sun drifts over the water.

facts.text: La Cava is a wine lounge serving aged vintages and fire-grilled prime cuts with Spanish flair.
facts.excerpt: A world of aged vintages and fire-grilled prime cuts, imbued with Spanish flair.

facts.text: Aqua has panoramic 180-degree views and crystal chandeliers.
facts.excerpt: Aqua features panoramic 180-degree views, with crystal chandeliers adding to a glamorous backdrop.

facts.text: Em Sherif Sea Café offers lunch and dinner menus, coffee, live music and shisha.
facts.excerpt: over a meticulously curated lunch and dinner menu, coffee, live music and shisha.

facts.text: Glo is an open-air poolside bar, and a Pool Pass is available.
facts.excerpt: An open-air bar for an evening beneath the Arabian stars. Soft melodies play as you savor refreshing cocktails and wines. Opt for a Pool Pass and soak up the sun's rays poolside.

facts.text: A residential fresh market sells hydroponic greens, herbs, edible flowers and artisanal bakery items.
facts.excerpt: An exceptional selection of fresh hydroponic greens, herbs, edible flowers and artisanal bakery items.

facts.text: Sense, A Rosewood Spa offers treatments that honor local healing traditions.
facts.excerpt: a diverse range of rejuvenating treatments carefully crafted to embrace and honor local healing traditions.

facts.text: The fitness center is on the second floor.
facts.excerpt: located on the second floor, the 24-hour Fitness Center contains state-of-the-art equipment dedicated to a range of workouts.

facts.text: Rosewood Explorers is a program of activities and amenities designed for young guests.
facts.excerpt: Designed for young guests, Rosewood Explorers is a thoughtfully curated world of play and discovery, where curiosity is inspired through engaging activities, tailored amenities and meaningful experiences.

facts.text: Dragon's Tooth hosts Tales of The Orient, with live storytelling, crafted cocktails and dim sum.
facts.excerpt: Experience stories of ancient empresses through live storytelling and specially crafted cocktails. Accompanied by a delicious selection of dim sum

facts.text: La Cava runs a whiskey tasting series covering spirits from Scotland, Japan, India and the Americas.
facts.excerpt: From Scotland to Japan, India to the Americas, each tasting invites you to savor the craft and character of exceptional spirits.

facts.text: In-room dining runs from breakfast to late night.
facts.excerpt: Savor exceptional flavors, delivered to your room. A curated culinary journey, from breakfast to a late-night indulgence.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself a contemporary waterfront landmark.
facts.excerpt: The contemporary waterfront landmark
